Commentary.Commentary: That is all from us. The trophy is handed to Buttler as England wins the ODI series. An entertaining series comes to an end but it is time for the focus to shift to shortest format of the game. The T20I series starts from the 9th of this month at 5.30 pm IST (12 pm GMT). Do join us for the build up. Cheers!

Tamim Iqbal says they were looking forward to this game, disappointed to lose the series but happy to win this one. Adds England played really well. Reckons this was not their best game but the bowlers stepped up today. Shares there are room for improvement. Says he is looking forward to the T20I series.

Adil Rashid is the Player of the Series. He says their bowlers bowled well throughout the series. On Rehan Ahmed, he has something special and hopes he gets better in future. Reckons they adopt to the conditions and have a game plan wherever they go.

Shakib Al Hasan is the Player of the Match. He says they have been playing well at home in past few years but despite losing, they showed good character in this series. He feels they were 10-20 runs short but the bowlers performed superbly. Applauds the performance of Mushfiqur Rahim in the end.

Jos Buttler says they wanted to win but still delighted to win the series. Adds it was a great opportunity for Sam Curran to bat up the order. Reckons they got what they wanted from this tour, they found this condition hard and are hoping to build on this series win. Shares he is looking forward to the T20I series.
...Presentation time...

When it mattered the most, the experienced players stepped up. The fifties from Najmul Hossain Shanto and Mushfiqur Rahim in the start and then, Shakib Al Hasan gave a perfect ending in the first innings to take Bangladesh near 250. Shakib Al Hasan was the one who started all with the ball as well, taking four wickets but others too bowled very brilliantly. A classic Shakib Al Hasan all-round performance which you will see regularly. England might have won the series but this win helps Bangladesh to avoid the whitewash.

All the bowlers were so disciplined with their bowling. The start wasn't as they wanted but once Salt fell, the wickets started to tumble down. There was not a single stand which gave a feeling of hope. Wickets kept on falling regularly and once Jos Buttler fell, it was all over. Chris Woakes tried his best but in vain. One big partnership could have helped England take this game deep or even win.
A superb performance by Bangladesh. There was nothing on stake but their experienced players stepped up. This was their best performance by far with the ball and it helped them to win.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! This time the wicket will stand. Length and on middle. Woakes chips it back to Rahman who takes to his right. He juggles at first but doesn't panic and takes in his second attempt Bangladesh win by 50 runs.
